fact: CRTS has generated composite drought index maps from satellite data monthly at national scale since 2003, with bulletins published monthly during agricultural seasons and distributed to end users, and its IRRISAT platform serves regional agricultural development offices and farmers.
title: Information submitted by Morocco for the midterm review of the Space2030 Agenda: Report of CRTS
publisher: Royal Centre for Remote Sensing (CRTS), Morocco / UNOOSA
